title: Museums and Science Centres for Kids and Teens
description: The best museums and science centres for families: free national museums, hands-on science centres, space centres and planetariums in the UK, US and Europe.
h1: Museums and science centres for families
intro: Dinosaurs, rockets, robots and hands-on experiments. Many of the best are free, and they’re the ultimate rainy-day plan.

image.alt: Visitors exploring a dinosaur fossil gallery

blocks.title: Scout’s museum verdict
blocks.text: Pick two or three galleries rather than trying to see everything. Ask at the desk for free kids’ trails and activity sheets.

sections.html: Turn a visit into a mission: spot five dinosaurs, find the oldest thing, or vote on the weirdest object. Read science centres for kids, space days out and free London museums.

faqs.q: Which museums are free in the UK?
faqs.a: National museums, including the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, British Museum and the national museums of Scotland and Wales, have free general admission.

cardText: Free museums, hands-on science and space centres.
